descriptions.preferred: 美峰 也有叫Bi Ho或者Bihoo ，是 源自日本的古老观枝品种 ， 1993 年于日本推广， 之后 由法国的Guy Mailot自日本引入欧洲 ， Bihou意味"美丽的山脉"，简称美峰 。 它四季皆可观赏 ， 春季叶片为粉色至泛红的浅黄色 ，再逐渐褪成黄绿 色，夏季变为浅至中等的绿色，秋季则呈现出亮黄色，且常常泛着红色色调。 它的新枝为粉色至泛红的橙色，冬季则变为吸引人的橙色至杏黄色。 这样的色彩可以维持几年。 美峰 的叶片主要为五裂，是典型的掌状叶，与流行的 "珊瑚阁（Sango kaku）"相似。 它的新枝和较幼嫩的枝干在冬季带来了非常清新的色彩 ， 与其他观杆类枫树 搭配，可营造出非常漂亮的意境。 美峰 生长速度强劲，午后需要 适当 遮阴 ， 成年 株高可达 3米左右 。

sources.name: Bihou Yellow Bark Japanese Maple
sources.description: Beautiful seasonal color makes this small japanese maple highly desirable. Leaf color starts out light yellow with pink, changing to green for summer. Branches turn yellow to apricot-orange in the winter. Grows to about 7 ft and hardy to minus 20. i apolize for the picture, it is all i currently have , but please look at pictures on the internet.

rhs.description: A bushy shrub growing to 2m tall. The yellow-green lobed leaves emerge in spring with a salmon-pink flush and turn shades of yellow and orange in the autumn before falling to reveal the golden-yellow and orange coloured stems

attributes.suggested_uses: Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants, Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, Low Maintenance, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 乡村/自然式花园、庭院/容器植物、建筑感种植、城市庭院花园、低养护花园、岩石园

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 丛生灌木，高可达 2 米。 黄绿色裂叶于春季萌发时带有鲑粉色晕染，秋季转为黄色和橙色调；落叶后显露出金黄色至橙色的枝条。
